content.text: All preferred elements appear satisfied across §§ 24.1–24.4. No redline needed.

input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets our preferred position. 24.1 lets us assign to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets without Vendor's consent (notice only), and 13.3 carries our licence rights across such a transfer. 24.2 bars Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld, and bars assignment to a direct Customer competitor. 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service on our change of control, so there is no walk-away trigger. Two points are noted only, not redlined: the competitor bar is framed as subject to our consent rather than absolute, and 24.3's mutual consent requirement for other assignments applies symmetrically, which does not disadvantage us given the broad 24.1 carve-out.
